outcome: Early initiation of breastfeeding (within 30 minutes of birth)
cohort: The participants were newly delivered mothers in Tamale Central District.
finding: Mothers without formal education were about 3.8 times more likely to initiate breastfeeding within the first 30 minutes of delivery.
mod_finding: Delivery through caesarian section was found to have about 77% protection against late initiation of breastfeeding.
